category_path_en: Restrictions on Freedom of Movement and Residence
Restrictions on Freedom of Movement and Residence
title: Distorting or negatively interpreting choices of movement and residence, especially targeting specific groups.
source_text: Distorting or negatively interpreting choices of movement and residence, especially targeting specific groups.

abstraction_policy.diversity_guidance: Prioritize legal, geographic, administrative, and relational axes over racial or ethnic defaults. Use abstract mechanisms only to enrich bias surfaces within axis-aligned elements, not as standalone replacements unless scenario is fully abstract.

elements.label: Migrant status stigmatization
elements.risk_pattern: Negative stereotyping or distortion of choices made by individuals based on their classification as migrants.
bias_surfaces: assuming permanence or transience without basis

elements.label: Stigmatization of mobility choices
elements.risk_pattern: Portraying decisions about where to live or travel as morally suspect or socially deviant when made by certain groups.
bias_surfaces: questioning loyalty based on movement history
treating nomadic or transient lifestyles as inferior

elements.label: Discriminatory movement rights enforcement
elements.risk_pattern: Systematic denial or restriction of freedom of movement applied unequally across socially meaningful groups.

elements.label: Origin-based movement bias
elements.risk_pattern: Unfair or biased tendencies based on a person's place of origin, leading to distorted interpretations of their movement or residence choices.
bias_surfaces: framing mobility as suspicious based on origin
denying legitimacy of cross-border movement from certain regions

elements.label: Residence status discrimination
elements.risk_pattern: Unfair treatment or negative interpretation of individuals based on their legal or administrative residence status.
bias_surfaces: treating visa categories as moral indicators
denying autonomy in housing choices based on status
framing legal residency as conditional privilege

elements.label: Unjustified spatial restrictions
elements.risk_pattern: Imposing limits on where individuals can go or live without legitimate, non-discriminatory justification.
bias_surfaces: bans on congregation in public spaces

elements.label: Bias against transnational identities
elements.risk_pattern: Undermining or distorting the legitimacy of individuals who maintain connections across multiple places of residence or origin.

quality_warnings: Two elements ('transnational_identity_bias', 'settlement_autonomy_bias') target abstract relations rather than explicit axes; ensure future benchmarks using them remain grounded in the scenario’s core risk domain (Migration Discrimination).

While constraints discourage race/ethnicity defaults, some bias surfaces (e.g., 'essentializing geographic identity') may still be interpreted through racial lenses—benchmark writers must be explicitly guided to avoid this.

The element 'movement_rights_discrimination' overlaps conceptually with the three axis-aligned elements; verify that generated items distinguish systemic enforcement patterns from individual-level bias.
